definition: Stable database identifier for a protein record.
interpretation_or_caution: An accession identifies a record; it does not by itself establish protein function or evidence quality.

definition: Sequence selected algorithmically by DeepClust to represent a cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a clustering anchor, not necessarily a known E3, the best annotated protein, the most ligandable member or a preferred species.

definition: Sequence assigned by DeepClust to a representative sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: Raw membership is deliberately broad and is checked again by exact representative-member realignment.

definition: Raw DeepClust cluster containing at least one accession matched to the inherited E3 seed table.
interpretation_or_caution: Seed support motivates review of the sequence neighbourhood but does not prove that every member is an E3.

definition: Any sequence assigned to an E3-seeded raw cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: This is broad discovery context; strict thresholds have not yet been applied.

definition: E3-seeded cluster member passing all exact post-DeepClust representative-member thresholds.
interpretation_or_caution: The production rule required identity at least 50%, representative and member coverage at least 50%, bit score greater than 20 and E-value at most 1e-10.

definition: Sequence absent from the inherited seed list that belongs to an E3-seeded cluster and passes every exact representative-member threshold.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a candidate homologue for review, not an automatically confirmed E3 ligase.

definition: Matched inherited E3 seed that fails at least one representative-based strict criterion.
interpretation_or_caution: It is retained as prior annotation and provenance rather than silently discarded.

definition: Alignment length divided by representative-sequence length.
interpretation_or_caution: This directional coverage is distinct from member coverage; both were required to pass the strict member rule.

definition: Alignment length divided by member-sequence length.
interpretation_or_caution: This directional coverage is distinct from representative coverage; both were required to pass the strict member rule.

definition: Percentage of aligned amino-acid positions that are identical in the representative-member alignment.
interpretation_or_caution: Interpret together with both directional coverages; a high identity over a short segment is not full-length homology.

definition: Normalised local-alignment score reported by DIAMOND; larger values indicate stronger sequence support.
interpretation_or_caution: It is one part of the strict member rule and should not be interpreted independently of alignment length, identity, coverage and E-value.

definition: Expected number of alignments of comparable score arising by chance under the search model; smaller is stronger.
interpretation_or_caution: DeepClust used a broad discovery value, whereas the exact post-cluster strict check required E-value at most 1e-10.

definition: Symmetric masking of low-complexity or compositionally biased sequence during DIAMOND calculations.
interpretation_or_caution: It reduces misleading similarity driven by repetitive composition while leaving the original protein sequences unchanged in published resources.

definition: Four-letter code embedded in an inherited One Thousand Plant Transcriptomes scaffold identifier.
interpretation_or_caution: It supports provenance and sample tracing; it is not a species identifier on its own.

definition: Fast protein sequence-alignment software used to build the search database, perform DeepClust grouping and recalculate exact representative-member evidence.
interpretation_or_caution: The post-cluster realignment is an audit of existing cluster assignments, not a second clustering step.

definition: Deterministic star-shaped alignment of every accepted member back to its assigned DeepClust representative.
interpretation_or_caution: It recalculates exact identity, coordinates, coverages, bit score and E-value; it is not an all-versus-all comparison or a multiple-sequence alignment.

definition: The representative sequence aligned to itself, giving one explicit self row per raw cluster.
interpretation_or_caution: Expected self rows are used as a completeness invariant for the realignment table.

definition: Protein region dominated by a limited set of residues or repetitive composition.
interpretation_or_caution: Such regions can create misleading similarity and are why the controlled tantan masking analysis was retained.

definition: Decision table in which each row represents one distinct reconciled evolutionary group.
interpretation_or_caution: It is not one row per protein, pocket or DeepClust cluster; linked one-to-many evidence remains in normalised tables.

definition: E3-seeded expansion of sequence space using similarity search, DeepClust grouping and exact realignment.
interpretation_or_caution: Discovery finds candidate sequence neighbourhoods; it does not establish orthology, E3 activity or ligandability.

definition: Traceable record explaining why a discovered cluster entered the analysis, including seed support, sequence thresholds, members, provenance and exclusions.
interpretation_or_caution: It supports audit and prioritisation rather than experimental validation.

definition: Evidence asking which proteins descend from the same ancestral gene across species.
interpretation_or_caution: It converts broad sequence neighbourhoods into the evolutionary-group decision unit.

definition: InterProScan and Pfam support for E3-associated protein-family architecture among assessable members and species.
interpretation_or_caution: Missing annotation is kept separate from an assessed absence of the required domain support.

definition: Expression Atlas support among uniquely mapped, assessable species and biological contexts.
interpretation_or_caution: It supports prioritisation but does not prove protein abundance, E3 enzymatic activity or expression in every target species.

definition: Checksum-bound read-only Stage 11 hand-off containing validated analytical outputs, manifests, environments and application resources.
interpretation_or_caution: A release records a computational authority; it is not an experimental nomination.

definition: Versioned, restartable part of the end-to-end analysis with declared inputs, outputs, validation and completion state.
interpretation_or_caution: Output-file existence alone is not proof that a stage completed successfully.

definition: Machine-readable file published only after a task or stage passes its required checks.
interpretation_or_caution: A valid marker is tied to the expected inputs and configuration; stale markers must not justify unsafe reuse.

definition: Writing results to a unique temporary staging area, validating them there and then publishing the final outputs as one completed unit.
interpretation_or_caution: This prevents partial files from being mistaken for completed results.

definition: Restart-safe mode that reuses only outputs whose inputs, configuration and completion evidence remain valid.
interpretation_or_caution: Resume should not silently reuse results after a scientific input or threshold has changed.

definition: Machine-readable register of effective configuration, inputs, outputs, checksums, versions and important counts.
interpretation_or_caution: The manifest is the audit authority for what was actually run, rather than what a command was intended to run.

definition: Fixed-length cryptographic digest, commonly SHA-256, used to verify that a file has not changed.
interpretation_or_caution: A matching checksum establishes byte identity, not scientific validity.

definition: Recorded lineage of data, commands, software versions, Git state, configuration, checksums and execution context.
interpretation_or_caution: Complete provenance makes a result reproducible and helps distinguish current authority from historical runs.

definition: Embedded analytical database used to query and join the integrated evidence efficiently.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a derived query engine; TSV, Parquet and manifests remain durable portable sources.

definition: Compressed columnar format used for large typed analytical tables.
interpretation_or_caution: It preserves data types efficiently but is not intended for manual reading in a text editor.

definition: Tab-separated text table used for portable, inspectable exports.
interpretation_or_caution: Tabs delimit fields; embedded list values use explicit separators and should not be split as if they were extra columns.

definition: Workflow engine that constructs the dependency graph and submits bounded scientific tasks.
interpretation_or_caution: A successful controller coordinates work; it does not itself establish scientific support.

definition: Cluster scheduler used to allocate compute nodes and record job state, resources and logs.
interpretation_or_caution: The login-node wrapper and log viewers do not perform the long scientific calculations.

definition: Maximum observed resident memory for the monitored process or process tree.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a resource-use measurement, not total allocated memory or disk use.

definition: Precomputed monomer model supplying three-dimensional coordinates and residue-level confidence.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a static computational prediction and may omit partners, ligands, alternative conformations and uncertain domain orientation.

definition: Macromolecular Crystallographic Information File containing model coordinates and explicit chain and residue identifiers.
interpretation_or_caution: The workflow uses mmCIF identifiers directly and never assumes author numbering equals FASTA numbering.

definition: AlphaFold local confidence estimate for each residue; higher values generally indicate a more credible local fold.
interpretation_or_caution: It is not a ligandability score. Project categories are below 50 very low, 50 to below 70 low, 70 to below 90 confident and at least 90 very high.

definition: Predicted aligned error between residue pairs, describing confidence in their relative placement.
interpretation_or_caution: PAE is especially important for cavities formed between domains; locally high pLDDT does not guarantee a reliable inter-domain orientation.

definition: Separate machine-readable per-residue confidence file supplied by AlphaFold Database.
interpretation_or_caution: It is an optional cross-check because pLDDT can also be read from the model mmCIF.

definition: Multiple-sequence alignment used to provide evolutionary and co-variation information to AlphaFold.
interpretation_or_caution: It is useful provenance but does not prove that the predicted conformation is biologically correct.

definition: mmCIF chain identifier from the model's label coordinate system.
interpretation_or_caution: Retain with label_seq_id and author locators so mappings remain explicit and reproducible.

definition: One-based residue position in the mmCIF model's label sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: It is checked against the authoritative Stage 05 FASTA sequence and residue identity before downstream use.

definition: Author-provided chain, residue number and insertion code retained in the mmCIF.
interpretation_or_caution: It can differ from label numbering and must not be silently treated as the FASTA position.

definition: Optional character distinguishing residues that share an author sequence number.
interpretation_or_caution: Non-empty or ambiguous insertion-code situations remain explicit during model-to-sequence reconciliation.

definition: Reconciliation of each selected model residue to the authoritative full protein sequence using explicit locators and residue identity.
interpretation_or_caution: This prevents shifted numbering or missing coordinates from creating false conservation claims.

definition: Status assigned when the one-based model label position is in range and the model residue identity exactly matches the authoritative FASTA residue.
interpretation_or_caution: Only exact mappings are accepted for downstream pocket comparison.

definition: One row linking a predicted pocket to one model residue.
interpretation_or_caution: A residue may occur in more than one pocket, so association counts are not counts of unique protein residues.

definition: Whole-model residue counts and pLDDT distribution used to assess general coordinate credibility.
interpretation_or_caution: A model can pass a broad confidence threshold while containing low-confidence local regions.

definition: Mapping and pLDDT summary restricted to residues assigned to one predicted pocket.
interpretation_or_caution: High local confidence improves coordinate credibility but does not prove that the cavity binds a ligand.

definition: Practical potential of a protein site to support useful small-molecule recognition and development.
interpretation_or_caution: It combines several evidence types and is broader than any single FPocket or P2Rank score.

definition: Geometrical depression or enclosed region on a protein surface identified as a possible small-molecule binding site.
interpretation_or_caution: A predicted cavity is a hypothesis; its existence and score do not establish binding or recruiter suitability.

definition: Open-source tool that detects cavities using Voronoi tessellation and alpha spheres and reports geometry and physicochemical descriptors.
interpretation_or_caution: Its pocket and druggability scores support triage but are not experimental binding evidence.

definition: Sphere contacting four protein atoms without containing another atom, used by FPocket to describe cavity geometry.
interpretation_or_caution: Collections of alpha spheres define predicted pockets; they are computational constructs rather than atoms or ligands.

definition: Machine-learning method used here to rescore and rerank the exact FPocket pocket set.
interpretation_or_caution: It does not define an independent cavity set or provide a second experimental measurement.

definition: P2Rank operating mode that reads FPocket cavity definitions and attaches learned scores, probabilities and revised ranks.
interpretation_or_caution: Pocket identity remains traceably linked to the original FPocket cavity.

definition: P2Rank model used for AlphaFold-like structures without relying on crystallographic B-factors.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a prioritisation model that still requires project-specific validation and expert review.

definition: FPocket cavity score derived from geometric and physicochemical descriptors.
interpretation_or_caution: It is distinct from FPocket druggability and P2Rank probability; disagreement between scores is informative.

definition: FPocket estimate of whether cavity geometry and physicochemical properties resemble sites tractable by small molecules.
interpretation_or_caution: It is not observed binding, affinity or PROTAC performance; the strict top-200 gate required at least 0.50 for every assessed member.

definition: Learned P2Rank output used to order the linked FPocket cavities.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a ranking signal, not a calibrated probability of experimental ligand binding.

definition: Single deterministic pocket retained for the primary stringent comparison in each assessed member.
interpretation_or_caution: Primary conclusions must not be silently replaced by results from alternative pocket ranks.

definition: Exploratory comparison allowing any of the five highest-ranked member pockets to match under the same structural superposition.
interpretation_or_caution: A rescue shows sensitivity to pocket ranking and does not overwrite the rank-one primary result.

definition: Fraction of a predicted pocket's residue associations mapped successfully to the authoritative model and FASTA sequence.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a data-integrity and eligibility measure, not a conservation or ligandability score.

definition: Fraction of selected-pocket residues meeting the configured pLDDT confidence threshold.
interpretation_or_caution: It measures local coordinate confidence; it does not measure cavity quality or chemical tractability.

definition: Multiple-sequence alignment program used to align evolutionary-group proteins and map exact FASTA pocket positions to alignment columns.
interpretation_or_caution: Sequence alignment can support a conserved pocket-bearing region but cannot alone establish a shared three-dimensional pocket.

definition: Connected set of group members whose mapped pocket-bearing sequence regions meet the configured pairwise support rule.
interpretation_or_caution: Its species/member coverage describes evolutionary breadth of the region, not necessarily local three-dimensional equivalence.

definition: Overlap between selected pocket-bearing regions after mapping residues to the group sequence alignment.
interpretation_or_caution: The primary analysis used at least 0.25 to connect supported regions; sequence overlap is not the 3D pocket-overlap metric.

definition: Deterministically selected model defining the coordinate frame for within-group structural comparisons.
interpretation_or_caution: Other compatible member models are aligned to this reference; unrelated E3 groups are not compared to one universal reference.

definition: Member model transformed by a structural aligner's rotation matrix and translation vector into the reference coordinate frame.
interpretation_or_caution: The transformed coordinates are used for pocket-position tests while the original model remains unchanged.

definition: Structural alignment method used as one independent backend for whole-model superposition and pocket comparison.
interpretation_or_caution: The strict 3D conclusion requires agreement with TM-align rather than averaging away disagreement.

definition: Structural alignment method used as the second independent backend for whole-model superposition and pocket comparison.
interpretation_or_caution: The strict 3D conclusion requires agreement with US-align rather than relying on one backend.

definition: Length-normalised measure of global structural similarity used as a prerequisite for local pocket interpretation.
interpretation_or_caution: The primary rule required at least 0.50; local pocket geometry is not interpreted when the global superposition is inadequate.

definition: Alignment of a mobile protein model to the group reference using a rotation matrix and translation vector.
interpretation_or_caution: It places pocket coordinates in a common frame but does not prove equivalent biological function or ligand binding.

definition: Arithmetic centre of the selected pocket's mapped C-alpha coordinates.
interpretation_or_caution: It summarises pocket position but does not describe cavity shape on its own.

definition: Distance between the reference pocket centroid and the transformed member pocket centroid.
interpretation_or_caution: The primary same-position rule required no more than 8 Å together with adequate global similarity and spatial overlap.

definition: Bidirectional fraction of pocket residues lying near a residue in the other transformed pocket.
interpretation_or_caution: It complements centroid separation so nearby but non-overlapping cavities are not treated as equivalent; the primary threshold was at least 0.50.

definition: Nearest or mutual-nearest pairing of transformed pocket C-alpha atoms within a configured distance.
interpretation_or_caution: The primary maximum pairing distance was 4 Å; it is a geometric correspondence, not an energetic interaction.

definition: Fraction of pocket residues participating in valid local structural matches after superposition.
interpretation_or_caution: The stronger conserved-3D rule required at least 0.50.

definition: Broad chemical grouping of amino-acid side chains used to compare local pocket chemistry.
interpretation_or_caution: Class agreement is coarser than exact residue identity and does not calculate interaction energy.

definition: Fraction of structurally matched residues whose broad biochemical classes agree.
interpretation_or_caution: The primary conserved-3D rule required at least 0.60 and should not be described as experimental chemical conservation.

definition: Requirement that both US-align and TM-align support the same group-level structural conclusion.
interpretation_or_caution: Tool disagreement remains explicit rather than being averaged into a pass.

definition: Abstract three-dimensional arrangement of interaction features useful for molecular recognition.
interpretation_or_caution: Here it is inferred from protein pocket residues rather than a known bound ligand, so it is a feature hypothesis rather than a measured pharmacophore.

definition: Residue-derived 3D points describing where a future ligand might need complementary hydrogen-bond, charge, aromatic or hydrophobic features.
interpretation_or_caution: It is not a ligand pose, docking result, interaction energy or affinity measurement.

definition: Feature that can donate a hydrogen into a directional interaction.
interpretation_or_caution: Typical protein contributions include suitable N-H or O-H groups on side chains or the backbone.

definition: Feature that can accept a hydrogen from a ligand donor.
interpretation_or_caution: Typical contributions include carbonyl oxygen or suitable side-chain heteroatoms.

definition: Feature that can carry or present a positive charge.
interpretation_or_caution: Often associated with lysine- or arginine-like basic side chains.

definition: Feature that can carry or present a negative charge.
interpretation_or_caution: Often associated with aspartate- or glutamate-like acidic side chains.

definition: Feature representing an aromatic ring capable of stacking or related directional contacts.
interpretation_or_caution: Typically contributed by phenylalanine, tyrosine or tryptophan side chains.

definition: Feature representing non-polar contact and favourable exclusion of water.
interpretation_or_caution: It describes a broad interaction preference and is not an energetic calculation.

definition: Overlap measure applied to feature counts and binned pairwise 3D-distance summaries.
interpretation_or_caution: Higher values mean more similar feature patterns under the chosen representation; they do not establish shared ligand binding.

definition: One minus the highest feature-pattern similarity to another assessed group in the current panel.
interpretation_or_caution: It is panel dependent and changes when candidates are added or removed; it is not a universal selectivity score.

definition: Common fragment-like property guidelines used to retain small, chemically tractable molecules for early screening.
interpretation_or_caution: Passing the heuristic does not establish binding, solubility in the assay, synthetic accessibility or plant activity.

definition: Explicit collection of small molecules supplied for compatibility ranking or later screening.
interpretation_or_caution: No fragments can be screened when the run is prepare-only and no library has been supplied.

definition: Open cheminformatics toolkit used optionally for structure validation, rule-of-three checks and two-dimensional compatibility ranking.
interpretation_or_caution: The open RDKit route is not FMOPhore, FrAncestor, docking or an experimental screen.

definition: Library used to read mmCIF coordinates and resolve chains, residues and atoms strictly.
interpretation_or_caution: It is a file and geometry parser; it does not score binding or chemistry.

definition: Candidate passing all configured chemistry gates plus stricter conservation, chemical-conservation and pocket-confidence thresholds.
interpretation_or_caution: It is the first expert review tier, not an experimental nomination or validated recruiter.

definition: Candidate passing all configured chemistry hand-off gates but not every stricter Tier 1 threshold.
interpretation_or_caution: It is eligible for project review before fragment prioritisation, not an automatic experimental selection.

definition: Evolutionary group with sufficient mapped, conserved, confident and tractable pocket evidence for the configured chemistry hand-off.
interpretation_or_caution: Read the exact gates and reasons; readiness is computational and does not mean a ligand exists.

definition: Run that prepares targets and feature hypotheses without requiring or screening a fragment library.
interpretation_or_caution: Empty fragment-ranking tables are expected in this mode and are not a failed analysis.

definition: Quantum fragment molecular orbital pharmacophore method intended to identify energetic binding-site hotspots.
interpretation_or_caution: NOT_RUN in the current campaign; FPocket/P2Rank and the open residue-derived feature route must not be reported as FMOPhore.

definition: Fragment-library design approach using molecular genealogy, properties, diversity and reaction-vector concepts.
interpretation_or_caution: NOT_RUN in the current campaign; the optional RDKit compatibility route is not FrAncestor.

definition: Complex-prediction system able to model proteins with nucleic acids, ligands and ions.
interpretation_or_caution: NOT_RUN in the current broad campaign; precomputed AlphaFold Database monomer models were used.

definition: Explicit status recording that a named method was not executed in the reported analysis.
interpretation_or_caution: It prevents prepared inputs or alternative open methods from being misrepresented as completed named-tool work.

definition: E3 ligase system that a bifunctional degrader recruits to ubiquitinate a protein of interest.
interpretation_or_caution: A computationally prioritised E3 group is only a recruiter hypothesis until biological and chemical validation.

definition: Ligand moiety designed to bind the selected E3 recruiter.
interpretation_or_caution: A predicted conserved pocket is only a potential handle; it does not mean a suitable ligand has been found.

definition: Protein intended to be ubiquitinated and degraded by the future bifunctional molecule.
interpretation_or_caution: It is independently selected by the target-binding ligand rather than by the E3 pocket analysis.

definition: Ligand moiety that binds the intended degradation target.
interpretation_or_caution: Its affinity, attachment point and selectivity must be developed separately from the E3-recruiting ligand.

definition: Chemical connection joining the E3-recruiting and target-binding ligands.
interpretation_or_caution: Length, flexibility and attachment geometry can determine whether a productive ternary complex forms.

definition: Complex containing the E3 recruiter, bifunctional degrader and protein of interest at the same time.
interpretation_or_caution: Binding of the two separate ligands does not guarantee a productive ternary geometry.

definition: Availability and positioning of target lysine residues for transfer of ubiquitin in the recruited complex.
interpretation_or_caution: A conserved E3 pocket does not establish that suitable target lysines will be presented to the machinery.

definition: Covalent attachment of ubiquitin to the recruited protein of interest by the cellular ubiquitin machinery.
interpretation_or_caution: It requires a functional recruiter and productive complex and must be tested experimentally.

definition: Destruction of a suitably polyubiquitinated target by the proteasome.
interpretation_or_caution: Predicted binding, pocket conservation or ubiquitination potential does not prove target degradation.

definition: Preference for the intended recruiter, target and degradation outcome over alternatives.
interpretation_or_caution: Within-panel feature uniqueness is not a substitute for cellular or organism-level selectivity testing.

definition: Ability of a compound to enter relevant plant cells or tissues, remain available and produce the intended biological effect.
interpretation_or_caution: These properties are outside the current computational workflow and require experimental measurement.
